notes: 2.4.6 through litellm: the same OpenAI/Python + x-stainless-raw-response headers as Aider, OpenHands and Open Interpreter; the one-line system prompt ('You are a helpful assistant that can interact with a computer.') and a single 'bash' tool with no stream, temperature or max_tokens (drop_params) carry the verdict, so any other tool name is a deny feature. The task and workflow text sit in the first user message. Identical on the first turn and after the tool call; a text answer triggers its 'No tool calls found' format-error loop (three rounds, then exit); no resume, so no follow-up shape. Needs MSWEA_CONFIGURED=true to skip the setup wizard and the 'mcp' package for litellm.
